headline: This proposal gives me the sources, observation times, and uncertainty I need to judge a recommendation.
nice_to_have: Include a clearly labeled example listing showing an unknown observation time and conflicting dated reports so I can see how those details will read together.
in_character_reaction: I want to know when someone visited, not just when they posted, and this makes that distinction clear. Entry rules belong to the specific location, and I can inspect the information without signing up. I would still keep a fallback, but this gives me useful details for choosing.
